Subject: Project Update: New Delivery Date of 14 April

We're writing to share an update on your project timeline. Certification of the third-party integration required for launch has taken longer than the vendor initially projected, and that dependency has pushed our schedule back by two weeks. The revised delivery date is 14 April.

Our team has already adjusted the internal plan around this new date and is continuing work on all components that don't depend on the certification, so the delay is contained to this single workstream. We're keeping close contact with the vendor to confirm there are no further slippages and will flag immediately if anything changes.

Does 14 April still work well with your own downstream plans, or are there scheduling constraints on your end we should factor in?
